notes.title: Update 0.4. A Leaderboard, Daily Tasks and more
notes.content:
Update 0.4 is now live!

Here are the main features


 New Daily, Weekly, and Monthly Tasks
 New leaderboard to see who the top earning employees of the Day/Week/Monthly/All Time are
 New Performance report board that shows some in game stats


In the next update I plan on adding more Tasks for the Tasks board as well as more stats showing how many Drinks you have Drank, Donuts Eaten, etc.

Hope everybody enjoys and I look forward to seeing all the names on the leaderboard!

notes.title: December 12th Update - Improved networking and animations
notes.content:
The December Patch notes for Security Control are:


 Improved networking, removed some unneeded networked objects
 Complete overhaul of the player animations to make them smoother.
 Made Santa free for the month of December
 Other bug fixes.

notes.title: French, Spanish, Italian, German Localization + Fire Extinguisher.
notes.content:
Added French, Spanish, Italian, German localization to the game.

Added the Fire Extinguisher, it creates a cloud of smoke that slows down and blinds the Security Guard.

notes.title: Biweekly Update Four
notes.content:
The fourth update on the development of Security Control.

Hopefully in the next update I can provide more screenshots on the cruise ship level that is being worked on. Until then here are the changes from the past two weeks.

Additional Content

 Added the ability to purchase skins for unlocked characters
 Added another objective to the demo


Gameplay Changes

 Added tooltips to see what objects are
 Added the ability to drink some drinks which allow the player to move faster for a short period of time
 Made Easy level easier
 Made it easier for first time players to understand the game
 Made Player Security sprint slower, drain stamina faster, increased base walk speed
 Decreased worker "Speed App' max speed



Bug Fixes

 Fixed some networking issues causing players to desync
 Fixed an issue where sometimes the game would not end
 Fixed some objective bugs
 Positional fixes for some objects to match on each players game


To stay the most up to date and find other players to play the demo with feel free to join the discord https://discord.com/invite/RArR9fSRQW

notes.title: Biweekly Update Three
notes.content:
Here is an update on the continued progress of Security Control.

Gameplay Changes

 Added apps to the Security Guard
 Flashlight is now built into the cellphone
 Two new apps Stream and Speed
 If the player holding the blue card is caught, the blue card goes to the security office.
 Ability to buy up to two additional apps


Bug Fixes

 Fixed an issue when trying to play in desktop mode with a VR headset plugged in
 Fixed an issue where the game would not end sometimes
 Fixed issues with host migration.
 Fixed a height calibration / reset issue.


Recently an audio mixer has also been added to allow the players the ability to control how loud some sounds are.

To stay the most up to date and find other players to play the demo with feel free to join the discord https://discord.com/invite/RArR9fSRQW

notes.title: Biweekly Update Two
notes.content:
With a successful Next Fest having just passed I'm continuing the Biweekly update to keep everyone informed on the development and changes made to the game.

Gameplay Changes

 Updated the security AI to avoid obstacles better.
 When a player is released from jail, it automatically goes into high alert mode.
 Added a camera in the security room to see who is in county jail.
 When security catches a player, it takes 3 seconds to handcuff them, this will allow other employees time to get away.
 Made Willow Suites slightly larger to make it easier for the employees.


Settings!

A lot of feedback about the game was about the lack of settings, in the past week I have been working on getting more settings into the game. I still have a few to add but hopefully once I get it all in it will allow a more customized gameplay experience.

The demo will continue to be updated with non content updates as I work on the game. If you have any feed back or suggestions please feel free to join the discord and message me. I'm always willing to listen (even if its negative).

To stay the most up to date and find other players to play the demo with feel free to join the discord https://discord.com/invite/RArR9fSRQW

notes.title: Biweekly Update One
notes.content:
With lots of progress being made in the past few months & Next Fest coming up, we will be releasing biweekly updates.

One New Environment, Three New Maps

A new workplace has been introduced, centered around the vibrant and bustling atmosphere of a mall, offering numerous areas to hide from the security guard along with brand new objectives. 

The three mall maps, "Pacific Palm Mall," "Grand Horizon Mall," and "Ivy Lane Shopping Centre" present a uniquely generated level and variety of experiences.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44772938/b5f1b46396791379bd422f1179cac11c43372240.png

Each new environment will have all new objectives related to that setting. Some new ones involve playing games at the mall arcade, while others are about getting revenge and trashing the mall.
